title: The client secret's custody (both read paths)
assertion: The web client is confidential and narrowed (user-auth only, no writable attributes); its secret is in Secrets Manager under the environment key, injected into the web container by the web execution role only; its resource policy denies reads to every principal but the web execution role and the custodian, and writes to all but the custodian (and the rotation's caller for `RotateSecret`); in Cognito, `DescribeUserPoolClient` and `ListUserPoolClientSecrets` are held by the custodian's role only, explicitly denied to the pull-request diff role, and granted to no other role in the stack; the worker's, platform's and screening's containers and the shared task role hold no read of it; the stack has no shared custom-resource read of the client; no env file, log line, error reason, serialised config or client module carries it; the stored value is a fixed literal until seeded, and any change to the secret re-runs the custodian's ensure step; rotation is on demand, Cognito-generated, scoped to this secret and account, refuses to delete a value running tasks may hold, and keeps the client ID; on staging the resource-policy deny is shown to override an identity allow (F3)
noFileReason: The client modules are scanned from source, the wrapper is serialised with a synthetic secret, and the stacks are synthesized in memory; no file.
